run_gtest_shuffle_test: run the googletest shuffle test suite to verify test shuffling behavior works correctly
test_shuffle_preserves_test_count: test that shuffling preserves the total number of tests across all iterations
test_shuffle_changes_test_order: test that shuffling changes the order of tests and test cases compared to original
test_shuffle_no_duplicates: test that shuffled test runs contain no duplicate test entries
test_shuffle_sharded_partition: test that sharded tests with shuffling preserve the complete test partition across shards
